scientific_integrity: The finite certificate enumerates all neighborhood multisets and all survivor sets; critical symbolic identities follow exactly. Independent scientific audit and validation have not been performed. No publication or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three permanently present plants, identically and independently surviving pollinators, unit matching capacity per pollinator, connected initially feasible graph and exactly one added link. The finite small-network certificate covers at most seven pollinators; the biological capacity model is stylized and empirical validation is absent. Historical priority is subject to independent literature review.
title: Seven pollinators are the sharp threshold for switching optimal interaction augmentation in a capacity-limited plant guild
